title: Data Structures and Algorithms with Go
title_original: Data Structures and Algorithms with Go: Create efficient solutions and optimize your Go coding skills
author: Dušan Stojanović
note: DS&A fundamentals through advanced graph algorithms, all with full Go implementations: arrays/slices/sorting, lists, stack/queue/priority queue, hashing/maps, binary trees + traversals, graphs (BFS/DFS, MST, shortest paths, max flow, topological sort, critical path).
